sources.title: Baseline Models: Your Guide For Model Building - Towards Data Science
sources.snippet: The Baseline Model A baseline model is essentially a simple model that acts as a reference in a machine learning project. Its main function is to contextualize the results of trained models. Baseline models usually lack complexity and may have little predictive power.
